scope: seven functional web improvements, local acceptance, not deployment or visual rework

requirements.name: Borradores seguros y control de edición
verified_contracts: encrypted text and file recovery after fresh access grant
account, assignment and resource separation
expiry, credential rotation and revocation
explicit recovery without automatic sending
CRDT recovery merges rather than overwrites
own undo/redo preserves remote operations and IME
PWA activation waits for protected work or explicit decision
requirements.native_evidence: plan phase 1 and October 29 PWA reload record; automation review reload in acceptance-automation-ui-20261029.json

requirements.name: Búsqueda real del historial
verified_contracts: full message, page and file metadata history
person, channel, dates and kind filters
stable signed cursor and exact context opening
access checked before snippets, counts, cursor pages and context
transactional index maintenance and PostgreSQL indexes

requirements.name: Menciones y seguimiento personal
verified_contracts: verified mentions in Slack, direct chat and pages do not grant access
unfollowed channel mentions honor personal notification preference
explicit personal thread following without duplicate channel notices
persistent personal saved references
personal unread marker does not undo actual delivery or read receipts
shared emoji reaction counts with own-only removal
reuse existing notifications and socket without conversation polling

requirements.name: De conversación a tareas y acuerdos
verified_contracts: normal Tasks project, section, assignee, date and pipeline
permission-filtered links in both directions
ordered selected messages become an independent agreement page
explicit consent, immutable retry and no duplicate task/page
no automatic sharing of private DM history or source access

requirements.name: Conocimiento estructurado
verified_contracts: same-channel subpages, breadcrumbs and deliberate moves
cycle and cross-channel rejection, independent structure version
internal page links, explicit aliases and access-filtered backlinks
block comments, replies, resolve/reopen and strict own authorship
safe inline formatting, literal code and official process templates
no second advanced Tasks/Sheets database system

requirements.name: Biblioteca de archivos y subidas recuperables
verified_contracts: full scoped image, audio, document and link history with authenticated downloads
explicit bounded PDF, UTF-8 TXT/CSV and Office container formats
aggregate temporary, managed and metadata budgets including QR
private encrypted durable upload reservation, worker lease and recovery
idempotent upload/publication, explicit discard and orphan reconciliation
composer and mixed forwarding review retain exact bytes and nonces
no public Google permissions

requirements.name: Automatizaciones acotadas
verified_contracts: task state, reminder and pinned-template periodic page only
private own-account/assignment rule configuration
create paused, explicit activation and versioned edits
current identity, pilot, channel and source authority before every execution
durable idempotent effect and result, bounded retry and missed-interval skipping
pause, audit, quotas and no history purge
usable forms, selectors and logs, encrypted recovery without replay
no arbitrary workflows, task writes, loops, voice calls or AI substitution
